app.description: Serve the App on 127.0.0.1 with a pairing token in the URL. File edits update the graph; graph edits rewrite the file. Runs use the same host and journal as ecp run. --config is optional machine settings; omit it to use ~/.ecp/config/config.ecp.ts when present, else installed plugins. The Environment tab shows the live process host. The App stores no secrets. Until 0.51.0 is on the registry, install with ecp plugins link plugins/plugin-app.
